repos.one_liner: A self-hosted, zero-maintenance quantitative trading and stock monitoring workbench for A-shares.
bullets: Built on TickFlow data architecture for high-frequency market analysis.
Supports automated stock screening, real-time monitoring, and backtesting workflows.
Integrates with third-party data providers like Tushare for extended financial datasets.
Designed for individual quant traders requiring a private, local-first financial dashboard.

repos.name: danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill
repos.description: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules, repurposed as a Claude Code skill for rewriting ambiguous agent-facing English.
repos.one_liner: A specialized skill for Claude Code that enforces Simplified Technical English (STE) standards for agent-facing documentation.
bullets: Utilizes the ASD-STE100 standard to reduce ambiguity in technical instructions.
Acts as a middleware layer to refine prompts and documentation for improved agent reasoning.
Optimizes communication between human developers and AI agents to minimize hallucination and error.
Essential for infrastructure teams managing complex, multi-agent system documentation.

repos.name: madeye/ServerBox
repos.description: ServerBox: turn a used Android phone into a Linux server, no root required. Alpine, Arch, Debian, Kali and Ubuntu with an always-on SSH server.
repos.one_liner: A utility to transform idle Android devices into functional Linux servers without requiring root access.
bullets: Leverages proot/chroot environments to run Alpine, Arch, Debian, Kali, and Ubuntu distributions.
Provides an always-on SSH server for remote management and infrastructure tasks.
Offers a low-cost, sustainable way to repurpose hardware for edge computing or lightweight dev environments.
Useful for developers needing portable, distributed infrastructure for testing or small-scale hosting.
